gloss: death with dignity; natural death without life-prolonging treatment

definitions.gloss: death with dignity; natural death without life-prolonging treatment
definitions.explanation: allowing a terminally ill patient to die naturally by forgoing or withdrawing life-prolonging medical treatment

examples.japanese: {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed death with dignity as a family.

examples.japanese: {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is still no law recognizing death with dignity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧になっている。
examples.english: As society ages, the debate around death with dignity is becoming increasingly important.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{尊厳|そんげん}→尊厳：12387_songen⟧ (dignity) and ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death). An important term in medical ethics and end-of-life discussions in Japan. Distinguished from ⟦{安楽死|あんらくし}→安楽死：18174_anrakushi⟧ (euthanasia), which involves actively ending life. {尊厳死|そんげんし} specifically means allowing natural death by not using or withdrawing artificial life support. Japan does not have a specific law on {尊厳死|そんげんし}, and the topic is subject to ongoing public debate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧: to wish for death with dignity
- {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to recognize/allow death with dignity
- {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: debate about death with dignity
- {尊厳死|そんげんし}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧: living will, advance directive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安楽死|あんらくし}→安楽死：18174_anrakushi⟧: euthanasia — actively ending life to relieve suffering
- ⟦{延命|えんめい}→延命：12484_enmei⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: life-prolonging treatment — medical care aimed at extending life
- {終末期|しゅうまつき}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧: end-of-life care, terminal care
